name: Packet Loss Tolerance
hypothesis: PTP maintains convergence up to 30% packet loss. Above 50%, drift degrades but doesn't diverge.
summary:
=== Experiment 32: Packet Loss Tolerance ===

Loss Rate | Convergence | Steady Drift | Jitter
---------|-------------|-------------|--------
    0.0%  |      100%   |  0.1112     | 0.0030
    5.0%  |      100%   |  0.1218     | 0.0034
   10.0%  |      100%   |  0.1269     | 0.0036
   20.0%  |      100%   |  0.1019     | 0.0028
   30.0%  |      100%   |  0.1159     | 0.0032
   50.0%  |      100%   |  0.1000     | 0.0029
   70.0%  |      100%   |  0.0837     | 0.0031

Retransmission comparison (50% loss):
  no_retransmit   : convergence=100%, steady_drift=0.1038, jitter=0.0030
  retransmit_2x   : convergence=100%, steady_drift=0.1023, jitter=0.0029

Hypothesis check:
  PTP converges at ≤30% loss: CONFIRMED (rate=1.0)
  Drift degrades but bounded at 50%: CONFIRMED (drift=0.1000)
  No divergence at 70%: CONFIRMED (drift=0.0837)
